reports.title: LDWF agents cite three subjects for hunting and fishing violations in Caddo Parish
reports.text:
Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries enforcement agents cited three subjects for alleged hunting and fishing violations in Caddo Parish.
On Oct. 14, agents cited Willie Dobin, 57, of Shreveport, for selling game fish and fishing without a basic fishing license.
On Oct. 16, agents cited Austin Gilmore, 24, of Vivian, for hunting deer during illegal hours, hunting without deer tags in possession, and failing to tag deer, and Carson Young, 23, of Vivian, for hunting deer during illegal hours and hunting deer without basic hunting and deer hunting licenses.

reports.title: Lake D’Arbonne State Park
reports.text:
This beautiful park offers much more than great fishing
Located at 3628 Evergreen Road, about six miles west of Farmerville, Lake D’Arbonne State Park covers 655 acres of Union Parish on the shoreline of the one the best fishing lakes in northern Louisiana. Lake D’Arbonne spreads across 15,250 acres of Union and Lincoln parishes. Formed by damming Corney Bayou and Bayou D’Arbonne, the lake resembles a crooked leaning “Y.” Stowe, Bear, Hurricane and other small creeks also feed into the system. Some highway bridges span the lake.
